# Gannons Solicitors

> Specialist commercial law firm in Central London offering expert contract drafting, employment law advice, and business legal services.

Gannons Solicitors is a London-based commercial law practice led by Catherine Gannon and a team of experienced solicitors. They provide comprehensive legal services across business contracts, employment law, tax planning, and corporate matters to businesses of all sizes.

## Key Topics

- Business Contracts
- Contract Drafting
- Contract Review
- Commercial Law
- Employment Law
- Intellectual Property
- Contract Negotiation
- Risk Management
- SaaS Agreements
- Partnership Agreements
- Joint Ventures
- NDA & Confidentiality
- GDPR Compliance
- Shareholder Disputes
- Legal Advisory Services
